dedupe_keys.name: qkdnetsim quantum key distribution network simulator

description: QKDNetSim+ is an extension of the QKDNetSim module for NS-3, published by its development team to study quantum-key-distribution communication networks. It changes the key buffer, cryptography handler and simulated quantum channel while retaining the overall network-simulator structure. The repository also describes an option to use a real quantum random-number generator for the simulated channel. Users configure network components and communication experiments, producing packet and key-management behaviour through NS-3 simulations. Spatial coverage and simulated duration follow the chosen network, not a fixed deployed system. The publisher code repository contains C++ and Python source, build instructions and a point-to-point test example, free under GPL-2.0 according to its licence metadata. This supports communication-capacity and key-management studies. A limitation is that the documentation gives an older Linux build workflow and a simulator extension does not establish physical-device fidelity. Existing platform-ns-3 is the underlying network simulator. The code was not compiled and no quantum hardware was accessed.
